title: Mimamsa corpus integration contract 2.0: shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the C16 corpus integration schemas (mimamsa-corpus-contract/2.0). Primitive identities (sha256, doc_id, date, relative path, page anchor) are reused from contract v1 (../v1/common.schema.json) so that v1 identities stay stable. The .invalid host is never resolved: the validator loads every schema from local files. Field status vocabulary used in the prose contract: MANDATORY (must be present and resolved), OPTIONAL (may be absent), UNRESOLVABLE (must be present; either a value or the 'unresolved' object below). JSON null means 'not applicable or not printed'; it never means 'unknown'.

contract.description: Contract identifier and minor version. Major 2 for this schema set; a breaking change needs major 3.

unresolved_reason.description: Why a value that should exist is not determined. NOT_DETERMINED: no rule or review has established it. CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE: sources disagree. SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: the evidence needed is not held. NOT_YET_PROCESSED: a pipeline step has not run. AMBIGUOUS_REFERENCE: the text admits more than one reading.

unresolved.description: Explicit UNRESOLVED marker. Used instead of guessing. Never used for 'not applicable' (that is null).

stable_id.description: Deterministic record id: a fixed prefix and the first 24 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the record's identity tuple (see C16_CORPUS_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT section 9).

corpus_generation_id.description: Producer-side corpus generation (a deterministic build of the corpus at pinned inputs). Not a site release generation.

instrument_code.description: C15 graph instrument code (GraphIds.CodeByPrimaryDoc: AA-1950, AR-1954, AFA-1950, NA-1957, AFT-2007, AFT-PR-2008, IPC-1860, CRPC-1973, IEA-1872, BNS-2023, BNSS-2023, BSA-2023) or DOC-<primary doc_id> for other instruments.

provision_node_id.description: C15 provision node id: PROV:<code>:<s|r|reg>.<base number> (GraphIds.BaseSection: 1-3 digits and up to two capital letters; sub-sections and clauses are not separate nodes) or PROV:<code>:part.<label>.

judgment_node_id.description: C15 judgment node id: JUD:<doc_id> when held, JUD:JG-<12 hex> when not held.

instrument_node_ref.description: Reference to a C15 instrument node by code. The INST:<family key> id is resolved by the consumer (GET /api/graph/resolve); producers never build INST ids by hand.

subject_node_id.description: Subject taxonomy node. SUBJ:<topic> for the controlled topic list (schema/document.schema.json topic enum); SUBJ:local:<slug> for an owner-collection subject not (yet) mapped to the controlled list.

chapter_node_id.description: Chapter (or Part) node within an instrument: CHAP:<instrument code>:<chapter label, upper-case roman or arabic>.

reference_node_id.description: C15 unresolved-reference node: REF:<16 hex of sha256(raw reference)>.

graph_verification.description: C15 graph verification vocabulary (Mimamsa.Core.Graph.Verification). DOCUMENTARY_CHECKED and LEGAL_REVIEWED come only from an authorised review process.

producer_verification.description: Values an automated producer may emit (GraphBuilder.Verification.BuilderValues).

temporal_status.description: Status of one temporal bound, aligned with C15 GraphEdge TemporalFromStatus / TemporalToStatus.

temporal_scope.description: Temporal scope of a relationship. Classification relationships are NOT_APPLICABLE (they are timeless navigation aids); a citation or treatment is AS_OF_SOURCE_DATE (the date of the citing document); legal-effect intervals need evidence for each bound.

local_relative_path.description: Path relative to a registered local collection root, POSIX separators, Unicode NFC. Never an absolute or drive path. Folder and file names are owner labels, not legal findings.

processing_step.description: One entry of processing history. Inputs and outputs are byte hashes; the step is reproducible from the named tool and configuration.

text_reliability.description: Aligned with Mimamsa.Core.Generation.TextQuality (reliable, partly_unreliable, unreliable, no_text) plus NOT_ASSESSED.

pagination_basis.description: What a page number in a derivative or anchor counts. SOURCE_PHYSICAL: physical pages of the original copy (PDF page index). RECONSTRUCTED_PDF: pages of a locally reconstructed PDF (not source pagination). GENERATED_SEGMENT: segments generated for a flow document (DOCX, HTML, TXT) that has no physical pages; never displayed or cited as a page. IMAGE_SEQUENCE: order of images in a container.

collection_ref.description: A registered source collection. Local collections are named, never by drive path.
